decision.observation: 6 mph, gear 1, timer 59:59.000, dots all pale again. The car is centred on the gravel; the road bends left then swings back right past dark pines, with pink 'SPEEDART' banners and a barn on the right verge and boulders on the left.
decision.hypothesis: The W+A beat cost 17 -> 6 mph to buy only a small alignment change — the car was already centred, so steering was wasted. The road ahead is passable from centre; rebuild speed with plain throttle and let the left bend pull the car right, which is fine here because the right verge opens onto grass.
decision.memory: Steering while already centred is pure speed loss on this stage (17 -> 6 mph). Banner text here reads 'SPEEDART' — a different sponsor from the earlier SPARDA/Nimkåddel set, suggesting a distinct section of route beyond the arch.
